source: Daniel's Running Formula — Jack Daniels, PhD
description: VDOT 54 is the target fitness level for a sub-three marathon. All race equivalencies and training paces below correspond to this VDOT.

race_equivalencies.note: Equivalent race times at VDOT 54. Hitting these times at shorter distances is a positive signal but does NOT guarantee marathon performance. Longer distances are stronger predictors.

easy.purpose: Aerobic base building — the foundation. Most weekly miles should be here.

marathon.purpose: Goal race pace practice. A few seconds faster than the 6:51 target to build a small buffer.

threshold.purpose: Lactate threshold work — intervals and steady-state efforts. Trains the body to clear lactate at higher intensities.

interval.purpose: VO2max development — short hard efforts to raise aerobic ceiling.

repetition.purpose: Neuromuscular / mechanics work. Unlikely to be used in sub-three training but included for reference.
